title: The claim he played with King Oliver and Jelly Roll Morton
summary: Howard denies playing with King Oliver; of Jelly Roll he says he knew him too well, left his band, and first saw Susie then.

story.theme_name: Pianists: who played, who influenced whom
story.community_name: Remembering Jelly Roll Morton: the man, the band

the early twenties, you played with King Oliver and Jelly Roll Morton, here. Is that right?
King Oliver and Jelly Roll Morton.
It said here, in the early twenties.
